title: Nostalgic French Onion Gratin
description: A garlicky and flaky French dish featuring shio-koji, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a nostalgic and savory meal, it is also egg-free-friendly and can be made using a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced onions and minced garlic and stir-fry until the onions are translucent.
Add the shio-koji to the bowl and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the melted butter, shredded gruyere cheese, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cheese mixture to the onion mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a raclette-grill vessel and cook for 20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the gratin from the grill and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Nostalgic French Onion Gratin hot and enjoy.
